note: PRIMITIVE CATALOG (rebuild-plan Phase B, layer 1). Atomic, fixed-size, corner-anchored bricks distilled from block-library.json + building-blocks.json. Each: fixed px @1280x720, anchor, exit-width (leftover docking slot), internal grid at 9.5pt, token refs, copy-recipe, the code component that renders it (or a TBD gap), and provenance. Structures (structures.json) arrange these into SlideStructure skeletons. Built in batches per component-queue.json.

conventions.bodyText: 9.5pt = 12.7px, Source Sans Pro, --fs-body. The ONLY non-title size (title 14pt=18.7px --fs-title; footnote 7pt=9.3px --fs-footnote; hero KPI --fs-kpi the single large exception).
conventions.labelCaps: small-caps device = 9.5pt bold, letter-spacing .08em (--ls-caps), uppercase, navy. NOT a smaller size.
conventions.contentRegion: x 20->1260 (1240px) . y 84->672 (588px). Primitives are placed by CORNER anchor inside this region and never stretched to fill.
conventions.fills: filled colour (navy/deal-primary) ONLY on KPI tiles, category/section bars, chart series, section dividers. Panels = grey small-caps header band + white body (PanelHeader), never a filled card. Placeholders = dashed grey; target logo = SOLID yellow + 1px RED border + 'COMPANY LOGO' 9.5pt navy caps.
conventions.shadow: house shadow (floating imagery only) = --shadow-house (0 0 9px rgba(0,0,0,.40), i.e. 60% transparency, 5pt blur, 0 offset).

tokenRefs.--tab-width: 22px vertical tab (NB: real renders show 44px — calibrate)

primitives.name: Content slide frame (title zone + body region + footer chrome)
primitives.exit_width: exposes the 1240x588 content region (x20->1260, y84->672) as the slot that skeletons fill
primitives.grid: title zone y24-46 (title 18.7px serif, optional italic body subtitle) + black 0.5pt rule y~70; content region y84-672; footer band y678-720 (42px)
primitives.recipe: SlideFrame variant='content': serif 14pt title (sentence case) + optional italic body subtitle + optional key-message band; black 0.5pt title rule; body = content region where a Phase-B skeleton renders; footer = grey 0.25pt rule then 42px band: left KumulusMark + 'Project X | Month Year' + confidential line; centre 7pt grey footnote; right FooterNav tabs + target logo + page number.

primitives.name: Cover frame (full-bleed image + centred serif title + date)
primitives.grid: full-bleed cover image or deal-themed gradient; centred serif cover title (--fs-page-title 34px) + date line
primitives.recipe: SlideFrame variant='cover': coverImageSrc (falls back to deal gradient), centred serif coverTitle e.g. 'Project X - Information Memorandum', coverDate.

primitives.name: Section-divider frame (big number/letter + frosted ToC agenda)
primitives.grid: full-bleed background (photo or white ghost) + large section number/letter + frosted ToC panel listing sections, active one highlighted solid yellow
primitives.recipe: SlideFrame variant='divider': backgroundSrc, sectionNumber, sections[] ToC with activeSection highlighted yellow.

variants.label: ghost-numeral
variants.note: white page, large outline-only numeral (e.g. '7', '7.1') at right + faint echo (BLK-SECTION-DIVIDER-GHOST)

variants.label: photo-agenda
variants.note: full-bleed product photo + translucent left agenda panel, current section on yellow bar (BLK-REAL-TOR-SECTION-DIVIDER-AGENDA-OVERLAY)

primitives.name: Footer section page-tab navigator
primitives.exit_width: sits in the 42px footer band; left of it = project/confidential lines, centre = footnote
primitives.grid: ordered tabs (n + label); active tab expands into a deal-primary navy banner with the section name; page number at far right
primitives.recipe: FooterNav: tabs=[{n,label}], active=n, activeLabel shown in navy banner, 9.5pt caps. Managed by SlideFrame footer.

primitives.name: Filled section/category bar (navy small-caps banner)
primitives.exit_width: full width of its host column; content docks beneath
primitives.grid: filled deal-primary bar, white small-caps 9.5pt label, optional leading icon + trailing chip/logo slot; height ~30px
primitives.recipe: SectionBar: label (uppercase small-caps), variant bar|chevron, height~30, optional icon + trailing. Filled colour — distinct from the grey PanelHeader band.

primitives.name: Grey small-caps panel header band (non-filled)
primitives.exit_width: tops a white panel body beneath it
primitives.grid: pale-grey band (~28px), centred or left small-caps 9.5pt bold navy label; hairline panel border
primitives.recipe: PanelHeader: the house panel device = GREY band header + white body (never a filled card). The single most-used chrome element across panels/matrices.

primitives.name: Navy vertical spine tab (rotated small-caps label)
primitives.anchor: far-left of a block/column, full height
primitives.exit_width: reserves the left 44px; blocks dock to its right
primitives.grid: solid navy bar, rotated 9.5pt caps label centred
primitives.recipe: VerticalTab: rotated uppercase small-caps label. NB: token --tab-width=22px but real renders measure ~44px thickness — calibrate the token.

primitives.name: Torino brand-nav header (ISMA/STUVEX/IExT tabs + geographies)
primitives.exit_width: sits in the title zone; any content construction docks below
primitives.grid: row of 3 brand chips (ISMA/STUVEX/IExT, each with mark); active chip SOLID yellow black text, others pale-grey. Beneath, full-width pale-grey 'MAIN GEOGRAPHIES' strip with small-caps label + country-flag chips
primitives.recipe: Render the active brand chip solid yellow, others grey; geographies strip with flag chips. Torino appendix/segment chrome.
primitives.component: TBD - GAP (Torino-specific, not yet a component)

primitives.name: Full-bleed photo opener with diamond-badge claim bar
primitives.grid: edge-to-edge photograph; a translucent pale-grey full-width bar carries a SOLID yellow rotated-square (diamond) badge with a bold black number + a serif claim line
primitives.recipe: Torino per-highlight photo opener (one per numbered investment highlight). Divider-family; distinct from the ToC divider.

primitives.name: Target-company logo placeholder (mandatory yellow)
primitives.grid: SOLID yellow fill, 1px RED solid border, 'COMPANY LOGO' navy 9.5pt caps
primitives.recipe: TargetCompanyLogoPlaceholder / TargetLogo: the swappable per-deal target asset; mandatory yellow placeholder when no real logo. Border is SOLID red (not dashed).

primitives.name: Third-party logo placeholder (grey)
primitives.exit_width: small fixed chip; tiles into logo grids
primitives.grid: grey framed box for supplier/customer/tech logos (deal content, NOT a brand asset)
primitives.recipe: ThirdPartyLogoPlaceholder: grey placeholder for client/supplier/partner logos (e.g. adix, HOERBIGER, Fagus GreCon on Torino; KAA Gent, PostNL on Bones). Never yellow.
